name: AdRad + Cassian Omi
description:
The AdRad team itself, does not seem to attract a lot of popularity, and mostly the missions with Rogue One unit requirements, are split onto a ROLO, Leia or CassU Fighters team instead.
The Cassian Omi, while also not fantastic, does help, but only works in a full Rogue One squad. So if you run the select units under other leads, the Omi does nothing.
Both Cassian and K2SO are needed on Kafrene, as well as Pao, Baze, Chirrut and SRP for Scarif, and AdRad you will have at r9 if you build Profundity, so both paths should be open to try.
notes: Omi is optional dependent on direction
